editorial:
When a strange wave of mass suicides sweeps across the northeastern United States, high school teacher Elliot Moore and his wife Alma hit the road to escape the chaos. What starts as a normal day quickly turns into a nightmare as people around them begin acting strangely and dying in horrible ways. The big question hanging over everything is simple: what is causing this? Is it a terrorist attack, a military accident, or something nobody expected? The movie keeps you guessing while building a tense, creepy atmosphere that makes every quiet moment feel dangerous.

The acting is a mixed bag, with some performances feeling stiff and others genuinely unsettling. The pacing moves quickly enough to keep you engaged, though the dialogue can be awkward at times. If you enjoy slow-burn thrillers with a sci-fi twist, this one is worth a look. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Elliot and Alma survive the attacks and settle down in a small town, expecting a baby. The big twist reveals that plants are releasing a toxin as a defense mechanism against humans, triggered when large groups gather. The movie ends with a similar event starting in Paris, showing the threat is spreading worldwide and humanity may not be able to stop it.
